caption: A gymnast performs a back handspring, landing cleanly on their feet on a padded floor.
positive_analysis:
The gymnast's supporting hand pushes off the padded floor, transferring weight to the feet as the body rotates backward.
The legs swing down from the vertical position, extending to meet the floor surface.
Both feet make contact with the padded mat, stabilizing the gymnast in a standing posture.

negative_analysis:
A single straight arm planted on the mat supports the athlete's horizontally extended body.
The arched torso and outstretched legs counterbalance around the supporting hand contact point.
If balance shifts, the torso and legs rotate together about the planted hand.
The raised socked foot marks the far end of the body's extended line.
